name: SugarKiss!
source:
The smoking room at Kenji’s company is small and intimate, allowing people to talk freely regardless of position. This was where he got to know Yuki well. Soon they started seeing each other in other places as well, and eventually they began living together. This is a story about working adults who fall in love over a cigarette.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/12/24/december-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
Kenji公司的吸烟室小而私密，无论职位如何，人们都可以自由交谈。正是在这里，他认识了Yuki。很快他们也开始在其他地方见面，最终他们开始住在一起。这是一个关于上班族因香烟而坠入爱河的故事。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/12/24/december-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
